title: Mass spectrometric analysis of 3’-terminal nucleosides of non-coding RNAs
protocol: Dissolve more than 0.8 μg of yeast tRNA<sup>Phe</sup> or mouse piRNAs in 13.4 μl of Milli-Q water.
Add 1.6 μl of 500 mM ammonium acetate buffer (pH 5.3) and mix gently.
Add 5 μl of RNase T<sub>2</sub> at a concentration of 5 units/ml and mix gently.
Incubate the mixture at 37°C for 3 hours.
Analyze the hydrolysate by using the LC/MS system.
